sn30.7-16:1.2: nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn30.7-16:1.3: Ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā aṇḍajānam supaṇṇānaṃ sahavyatam upapajjatīti || || 4
sn30.7-16:1.4: Idha bhikkhu ekacco kāyena dvayakārī hoti vācāya dvayakārī manasā dvayakārī ||
sn30.7-16:1.6: Aṇḍajā supaṇṇā dīghāyukā vaṇṇavanto sukhabahulā ti || || 5
sn30.7-16:1.8: Ahovatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā aṇḍajānaṃ supaṇṇānaṃ sahavyatam upapajjeyyan ti || || 6
sn30.7-16:1.19: so kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā aṇḍajānaṃ supaṇṇānaṃ sahavyatam upapajjati || || 7
sn30.7-16:1.20: Ayaṃ kho bhikkhu ayam paccayo yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā aṇḍajānam supaṇṇānaṃ sahavyatam upapajjatīti || || 1-3
